testConventions: Vitest 5.0.0 tests live in packages/<project>/test/**/*.test.mjs and run through the uncached Nx test target of that project
Each Vitest config writes junit.xml and lcov.info under .ci/nx/<project> or GREENFIELD_REPORT_DIR
Scoped and affected tiers take a scope-manifest-json-v1 file: node scripts/run-nx-test-tier.mjs '{manifest}'
The impacted tier takes a git range: node scripts/run-nx-test-tier.mjs '{range}'
